description: Lista aeroporturilor din Romania is a dataset listed in data.gov.ro, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerul Transporturilor. List of Romanian airports referred to in Article 1(2) of Government Decision No 455/2011 on airport charges. Coverage: Ministerul Transporturilor. The portal shows the English title as "List of airports in Romania" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerul Transporturilor. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2016-01-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ro.
